summary: @onereach/webform preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes obfuscated bundled payload
details: The package's `preinstall` hook runs `setup.mjs`, an obfuscator.io-style script (hex-identifier names, per-call proxy dictionaries) that downloads the Bun runtime from `https://github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases/download/bun-v<ver>/<arch>.zip` into a tmpdir, extracts and chmods the `bun` binary, then invokes it to execute the sibling `math_init.js`. `math_init.js` is a 727KB Bun-compiled CJS file (`// @bun @bun-cjs`) with a string-array + rotating-shift decoder (`WV8StW`) and mangled globals — the filename bears no relation to any functionality the package documents (a Vue webform library). Installing the package causes an alternate language runtime to be fetched at install time and used to execute an opaque, heavily obfuscated bundle on the installer's machine, bypassing scanners that only inspect Node-resolved source. The launcher script's obfuscation of platform detection, download, unzip, chmod, and exec logic is inconsistent with any legitimate native-build install helper for a Vue component library.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
